isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: In Isaiah 6, the seraphim proclaimed that the whole earth is full of the Lord's glory.
isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.feedbackCorrect: The seraphim link the Lord's holiness to the glory that fills the earth.

feedbackWrong.false: Reread the end of Isaiah 6:3, where glory fills the whole earth.

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: In Isaiah 6:1, tap who Isaiah saw seated on the throne.

options.a: They covered the throne to hide it from Isaiah

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: Put Isaiah 6:1 in the order of the text.
isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.feedbackCorrect: The verse starts with Uzziah's death, shows the Lord on the throne, and ends with the temple full.

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.hint: The verse begins by marking the year.

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: What does Isaiah 6:3 say that connects to this context?

options.a: The temple was left empty

isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.feedbackCorrect: The question about who will be sent comes after the coal and the forgiveness.

options.a: Isaiah promises never to speak again

isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: How does the scene unfold in Isaiah 6:3–4?
isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.feedbackCorrect: First the proclamation, then the shaking doorposts and the full house.

feedbackWrong.default: Start with the seraphim's proclamation; the full house closes the scene.

isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.hint: The proclamation comes before the doors react.

options.a: The seraphim proclaim the Lord's holiness
options.b: The voice shakes the doorposts

feedbackWrong.c: The sin is not hidden; it is removed and forgiven.

isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.hint: Read the second half of the seraph's words.

isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: What connects Isaiah 6:9–10 to Matthew 13:14?
isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.feedbackCorrect: Jesus quotes Isaiah to speak of those who hear the word without understanding.

isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.hint: Compare what happens to those who hear in both texts.

options.a: Hearing without understanding

isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: In Isaiah 6, Isaiah only offers to be sent after his sin is forgiven.
isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.feedbackCorrect: First the coal and forgiveness; only then does Isaiah say he can be sent.

isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: In Isaiah 6:5, tap the part where Isaiah names his problem before the King.

isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: Which sequence shows the path of worship that begins in Isaiah 6:3?

options.a: Isaiah hears the seraphim by the throne
options.b: John links Isaiah's vision to glory

isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: In Isaiah 6:3, which word repeated by the seraphim sums up who the Lord is?
isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.feedbackCorrect: Repeated three times, the word marks the whole scene of the throne vision.

isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.hint: It is the word the seraphim repeat three times.

isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.question: What connects Isaiah 6:3 to Revelation 4:8?
isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.feedbackCorrect: In both texts, beings by the throne proclaim the Lord as three times holy.

isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-01-visao-do.hint: See what the beings in both texts proclaim.

options.a: Silence before the throne
options.b: Worship of the holy Lord
options.c: The end of worship in heaven

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.question: In Isaiah 6:8, Isaiah answered that someone else should be sent in his place.

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.hint: Read the final answer in the verse.

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.question: In Isaiah 6:8, tap the words with which Isaiah offers himself to the Lord.

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.question: According to Isaiah 6:9, what does God tell Isaiah to say to the people about hearing?

options.a: They will see and know everything at once

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.question: Put Isaiah 6:8 in the order of the text.
isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.feedbackCorrect: First Isaiah hears, then comes the question, and then his answer.

isaias-sem-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.question: What does Isaiah 6:13 say that connects to this context?

options.a: A holy seed remains

isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.question: Isaiah's message would make the people turn quickly and be saved.
isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.feedbackCorrect: The announcement foresees closed ears and hearts, with no conversion at that time.

isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.question: In Isaiah 6:10, tap the word that links the closing of the eyes to its effect on the people.

isaias-cam-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.question: How do the steps in Isaiah 6:8–9 connect?

options.a: Conversion without any understanding

isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.question: Even while announcing desolation, Isaiah 6 ends by speaking of a stump that is a holy seed.
isaias-pro-isaias-chamado-is-02-aqui-est.feedbackCorrect: The chapter closes with real judgment, but also with a remnant kept safe.
